Dare to Dream by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 At the end of a quiet cul-de-sac in Seacrest, Dare to Dream makes vacation life easy, especially when the private beach is just a 59-second golf cart ride away (yes, someone timed it). Surrounded by Watersound and Alys Beach, with plenty of spots to eat, shop, and wander. Out back, a private, shady patio is made for lazy afternoons, with lounge chairs, outdoor dining, and zero rush to be anywhere. Inside, the living area is roomy and relaxed, the kitchen’s fully stocked, and the dining table fits seven. On the main floor, there’s a guest room, queen, with French doors to the backyard, and a playful bunk room down the hall that’s made for the kids (or kids-at-heart). They share a full bath with a tub/shower combo. Upstairs, the primary suite is all yours, complete with a private bath, dual vanity, and another tub/shower combo for end-of-day unwinding. Oversee 30A is local, responsive, and always a text away. We’re here every day to help keep things smooth, and our 24/7 emergency line is ready just in case something weird happens (like a toaster rebellion). Overview: - .5 miles to the beach (Seacrest Drive Access) - 3 bedroom, 2 bath - 1704 square feet - 4-seater golf cart (For beach and neighborhood use only) - Propane grill - Wi-Fi - 2 bikes included - Dogs considered, an additional $210 nonrefundable fee for each dog Overnight: FIRST FLOOR - Guest Room: Queen bed, shared bathroom, private access to back yard, TV - Bunk Room: Twin over full with trundle, shared bathroom, private access to back yard, TV SECOND FLOOR - Primary Bedroom: King bed, private bath, TV Check-in is 4:00 PM CST.

Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
